descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Cultural Heritage Editorial for CHIDAMBARAM NATYA AW26 Bharatanatyam heritage drop. Subject: an Indian Bharatanatyam dancer 24, of Tamil-Chola lineage, oiled jet-black hair in a ceremonial rajakesari bun wreathed with fresh mallipoo jasmine string, ornamental chutti rakodi and surya-chandra crescents mounted along the centre part; Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush across cheekbones and brow beneath stage warmth. Wardrobe: a traditional stitched Bharatanatyam costume in costume-crimson #A01828 Kanjeevaram silk, pleated fan aalavattam panel opening at the knee, bodice and dhavani sash worked in costume-gold-zari #D4A338 pure-zari mayil-kan and kalka weave, a contrasting emerald border; jewelry-temple-gold #E8C256 full temple-jewelry set — oddiyanam waist-belt, vanki arm-band, maangamalai and kasumalai necklaces, jimikki jhumka earrings, long nethichutti with surya-chandra, a single red kumkum bindi; ghungroo ankle-bells; alta-red dyed palms and feet. Pose: classic alidha-stance ardhamandali with a pataka-hasta mudra. Setting: a temple-stone-shadow #5A4838 Chola-granite temple corridor in shallow focus, carved pillar reliefs, brass nilavilakku flame dancing. Composition: Rule of Thirds torso 42% x 48% y, hero vertical, Eye-Level 0°, body 3/4 turned, gaze direct drishti. Camera: Sony A7R V · 85mm f/2.0 · 1/250s · ISO 400. Lighting: Stage Tungsten Warm Side Lighting + Rim Lighting — warm theatre spot camera-right 45° elevation 3m (key tungsten), 4×4ft gold bounce camera-left 1.5m (fill on face), 1×3ft strip rim camera-back 30° grazing aalavattam zari pleats (rim highlighting mayil-kan), 4×4ft black flag below left to deepen stone corridor. Material physics: Kanjeevaram silk heavy hand-loom weight, pure-zari real-gold-thread mayil-kan motif raised weft, temple-gold high-carat specular, mallipoo petal matte, ghungroo brass cluster specular. Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 emulation grain 6 +0.3 EV. Palette: costume-crimson 24%, costume-gold-zari 22%, jewelry-temple-gold 14%, temple-stone-shadow 22%, skin-warm-south-asian 18%. References: Raghu Rai temple dancer, Rukmini Devi archive, Vogue India classical. Exclude: harsh flash, plastic skin, AI hallucination artifacts, cropped extremities, muddy shadows.
